name: memento
description: A lightweight micro-framework that gives Claude Code a memory across sessions in any project. Two commands carry the whole work cycle: /session-start agrees the objective, loads the accumulated project knowledge and plans the stages; /session-close verifies the results and distills them into a versioned knowledge base under docs/ai/ (session log, project map, learnings ledger, decision records). /session-init bootstraps a project once. Two read-only helpers keep it healthy: /project-brief summarises where the project stands, /memento:doctor audits the knowledge base for stale, broken or inconsistent records. Profiles adapt it to the kind of work — code for software, analysis for data pipelines, models and metrics, where a validated check means reconciliation rather than a passing test. Generated documents can be written in any language; English is the default.

document_language.title: Document language
document_language.description: Language for the documents this plugin generates: session logs, PROJECT.md, LEARNINGS.md and decision records. Write the language name, for example English, Spanish or Portugues. A repository can override this in docs/ai/config.yml. Skill instructions themselves always stay in English.
